verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any document-free identity check against authoritative databases such as SSN, national registries, or credit-header data. The documented reports cover document authenticity, facial similarity, known faces, NFC, and watchlist screening. Watchlist reports screen applicants against sanctions, PEP, and adverse-media lists, which is a related compliance feature but not database identity verification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can verify identity against authoritative databases without documents — SSN, national registries, or credit-header data — for lower-friction flows where a doc scan is overkill
